before: Joining paragraphs after a tracked-change decision looked up the rest of the body for each block, and each decision indexed the whole part to find content controls.
after: The join reads each block once, a part without content controls skips the control lookup, and a decision that removes records from a few paragraphs patches their cards instead of deriving the whole queue. The tree and the queue are the same.
reason: Only the cost of a decision changes. The resulting tree, node ids, operations, and package serialization are the same.
